procedure: Bind the current mandate and constraints.
Define reader decision, perimeter, dates, cutoff and document mode.
Set feasible deliverables and purpose-specific acceptance conditions.
Return the frame and material mandate gaps.

acceptance.expectation: Input and output artifact locations, versions and actual hash/access observations are recorded; dates and cutoff are distinct fields.
The decision, audience, perimeter, mode and conclusion strength follow the mandate without issuer assumptions or invented authority.
Acceptance reflects actual access and output capabilities, preserves factual versus fictional board modes, and promises neither FDD completion nor assurance from screening.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
